# MD Human Review

> Markdown review & annotation extension for VS Code and VS Code–based editors (Cursor, Windsurf, CodeBuddy IDE, Trae). Comment, mark deletions, insert content, edit in Rich Mode, and generate AI fix instructions in one click — like a mentor grading papers.

## What it does

- **Review** rendered Markdown with comments (image attachments), deletion marks and content insertions
- **Edit** in Rich Mode (ProseMirror) with a formatting toolbar, tables, links, diagrams and local images
- **Generate AI fix instructions** from all annotations (`Ctrl+E` or one click); sent to CodeBuddy / Cursor / Windsurf chats, clipboard fallback elsewhere
- **Render** full GFM plus Mermaid, KaTeX, PlantUML (online) and Graphviz (local Viz.js)
- **Persist** annotations in the workspace `.review/` directory with per-content-change version history; optionally write comments into the source as `[^mdhr-N]` footnotes and restore them on reopen

## Why it is different

1. Full annotation workflow — comments, deletion marks and insertions on the rendered document, not just a preview.
2. Structured AI instructions ordered back-to-front so edits stay safe.
3. WYSIWYG editing with structure-preserving Markdown round-trip (tables, footnotes, diagrams, math).
4. TOC, search, image lightbox, Zen mode, light/dark themes and extensive typography settings.

## Install

Search **"MD Human Review"** in your editor's marketplace.

- VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=letitia.md-human-review
- Open VSX (Cursor / Windsurf): https://open-vsx.org/extension/letitia/md-human-review

## Technical details

- TypeScript + VS Code Extension API; webview bundled with esbuild (ESM); ProseMirror for Rich Mode; marked for preview
- Supported files: `.md`, `.markdown`, `.mdc`
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux
